verdict.rationale: Moss's own indexing docs describe document operations in the plural: upserting more docs, fetching specific docs, and deleting docs. Core concepts also say several indexes can be loaded at once for a single query. This suggests multi-item operations, but there is no explicit batch or bulk API. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch endpoints with limits, bulk updates or deletes across many items via CLI or MCP, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Upsert more docs later ... Fetch specific docs ... Delete docs or the index when done
You can also load several indexes at once for a single query, then unload them when done.
